- Affected part: lower stem/hypocotyl at soil level
- Reddish-brown to dark brown sunken lesion
- Dark circular spot within the lesion
- No white mold, no foliar symptoms visible

Top candidates: **Rhizoctonia** (reddish-brown hypocotyl lesions), **Phytophthora** (chocolate-brown stem discoloration from soil line), **Fusarium** (reddish-brown root/stem discoloration).

The reference image for Rhizoctonia is nearly identical to the test image — same hand holding a soybean stem at soil level with the same reddish-brown to orange-brown lesion with a dark circular spot. The match is essentially exact in color, pattern, location (hypocotyl at soil line), and photographic angle.
